# UI contract

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

The agreed states and inputs of each interface component, written down before the team builds the component. A Storybook story captures the rendered state of a UI component, and a component gets a story for each interesting state that it supports. Component Story Format is an open standard for stories, based on ES6 modules.
